_comment: One entry per UART link. name = ALSA port name. All enabled links are equal members of the MIDI bus (midi_passthrough.py): whatever is plugged in gets the whole MIDI flow and can send to everyone. baud must match the XIAO firmware (250000). loglady is reserved for Teletype (loglady-teletype.service). Apply changes: sudo systemctl restart xiao-uart-bridge

links.name: mysteryman
links.pins: uart0: GPIO14 TX (pin 8) / GPIO15 RX (pin 10) / GND pin 6

links.name: jumpingman
links.pins: uart3: GPIO4 TX (pin 7) / GPIO5 RX (pin 29) / GND pin 9

links.name: nadine
links.pins: uart4: GPIO8 TX (pin 24) / GPIO9 RX (pin 21) / GND pin 25

links.name: loglady
links.pins: uart5: GPIO12 TX (pin 32) / GPIO13 RX (pin 33) / GND pin 34
links.note: reserved: loglady is the Teletype link (loglady-teletype.service), not a MIDI port
